subject: Exception conditions
notes: Rule: §14.6.13.1.4 1) (cite.py --check 14.6.13.1.4 "the imperative statement associated with that conditional phrase is executed as specified in the rules for the specific statement" -> OK 1)). Code: EmitOverflow sets the status and runs no dispatch when hasPhrase; __IoCheckEc returns -1 before any selection when the statement's AT END / INVALID KEY / ON EXCEPTION / END-OF-PAGE phrase covers the raised family. The named test: >>TURN EC-I-O ON, USE AFTER EC EC-I-O-AT-END, READ ... AT END -> 'ATEND' only. Probe g1 (out/probe/exc-nonfatal) additionally shows a propagated EC-USER condition does not enter the CALL's ON EXCEPTION phrase, which is §14.9.4.4 GR3i's own routing - 'as specified in the rules for the specific statement'. || editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (EC model introduced by ISO 2002)
